resources.string: Covers other apps while an AWAKEN focus session is running. It only notices which app opens. It reads no screen content, typing or messages, and nothing leaves your phone.
Ending a session early pays no reward.
You ended the session early. No reward.
A distracting app was opened during the session.
Focus Lock covers other apps while a focus session is running, so the session stays a session.
To do this, AWAKEN uses an Android accessibility service. It detects which app comes to the foreground during a running focus session, so it can cover that app.
It listens only for a new window opening, and reads only the name of the app.
It reads no screen content, typing, passwords, messages or notifications.
It watches only AWAKEN when no session is running, and does nothing when the session is paused.
It never covers or watches phone, messages, emergency, Android settings, payment and UPI apps, the keyboard, your launcher or AWAKEN.
It stores nothing about the apps you open. Nothing leaves your phone.
You can turn it off at any time.
Open Android accessibility settings, find AWAKEN in the list of apps and switch it on. Then come back here.
Focus Lock is switched on in Android.
If the switch is greyed out: open AWAKEN app info, tap the three-dot menu, choose Allow restricted settings, then try again. Android 13 and newer do this for apps installed outside Google Play.
Some phones stop background apps to save battery. If they stop Focus Lock, apps are not covered. These steps help.
1. Open Autostart and switch AWAKEN on.\n2. In Battery saver for AWAKEN, choose No restrictions.\n3. In recent apps, press and hold AWAKEN and lock it.
1. Open Battery, then Background usage limits.\n2. Remove AWAKEN from Sleeping apps and Deep sleeping apps.\n3. Set battery use for AWAKEN to Unrestricted.
1. Allow Auto-launch for AWAKEN.\n2. In battery settings for AWAKEN, choose Allow background activity.\n3. In recent apps, lock AWAKEN.
1. In Battery optimisation, set AWAKEN to Not optimised.\n2. Allow Auto-launch for AWAKEN.\n3. In recent apps, lock AWAKEN.
1. Allow Autostart for AWAKEN.\n2. In Background power consumption, choose Allow high background power consumption.\n3. In recent apps, lock AWAKEN.
1. Open App launch and set AWAKEN to Manage manually.\n2. Switch on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.\n3. In recent apps, lock AWAKEN.
1. Set battery use for AWAKEN to Unrestricted.\n2. Allow AWAKEN to run in the background.\n3. Keep AWAKEN in recent apps; do not swipe it away.
It starts covering apps the next time a focus session runs. Choose apps to leave uncovered in Settings, under Allowed apps.
Cover other apps while a focus session runs.
Switched on in Android accessibility settings
Apps Focus Lock leaves uncovered during a session.
Used when Focus Lock is off: if a Distracting app is opened during a session, the session ends with no reward.
Ticked apps stay usable during a focus session. Everything else is covered.
Focus Lock is on but not running, so apps are not covered. Time away from AWAKEN still counts against the session.
